EntratiSyndicate.descriptionEn: Heirs to the legacy of Albrecht Entrati, his powerful Orokin family encountered disaster, isolation and bitter division on Deimos. The arrival of the Tenno, beneficiaries of their Void research, may bring fresh hope - and a deeper understanding of the world that has trapped their family.
EntratiSyndicate.descriptionZh: 他们是阿尔布雷希特·英择谛的继承人，这个强大的奥罗金家族在火卫二上遭遇了沉重的灾难、孤离和痛苦的分裂。而虚空研究的受益者，Tenno 的到来，或许会给这些可怜的人们带来新的希望；以及进一步探索这个困住了他们的诡秘世界。

NecraloidSyndicate.descriptionEn: While the Entrati family's cohort of lethal Necramechs succumbed to the corrupting influence of Deimos, Loid's shielding kept him sane, as well as preserving what was left of his ‘passenger', the Cephalon Otak. Together they maintain a proud tradition of loyal service.
NecraloidSyndicate.descriptionZh: 当英择谛家族引以为傲的致命殁世机甲都屈服于火卫二上的腐朽势力时，洛德的护盾使他得以保存理智；也一并保住了他当时的"乘客"所幸存的一切——中枢奥塔。他们一起协力维持住了忠诚服务这个傲人的传统。

EntratiLabSyndicate.name: Cavia

titles.name: /Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGeneral/EntratiLabSyndTitle5
titles.descriptionEn: You, Loid and the Cavia have achieved a breakthrough. None of you will ever be quite the same again.
titles.descriptionZh: 你、洛德和科维兽已经取得了突破。你们谁都不会和以前一样了。

titles.name: /Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGeneral/EntratiLabSyndTitle4
titles.descriptionEn: Your patience is bearing fruit, even as looming disaster threatens.
titles.descriptionZh: 尽管灾难迫在眉睫，但你们的耐心正在结出硕果。

titles.name: /Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGeneral/EntratiLabSyndTitle3
titles.descriptionEn: Despite the chaos and tragedy in the Labs, your vigilant attention to duty has not faltered.
titles.descriptionZh: 尽管实验室发生了混乱和悲剧，但你对职责的警惕性丝毫没有减弱。

titles.name: /Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGeneral/EntratiLabSyndTitle2
titles.descriptionEn: Your work with the Cavia makes steady progress, despite fomenting disagreements.
titles.descriptionZh: 尽管存在分歧，但你与卡科维兽的合作取得了稳步进展。

titles.name: /Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGeneral/EntratiLabSyndTitle1
titles.descriptionEn: You have helped Loid in his work with the Cavia, though much remains to do.
titles.descriptionZh: 虽然仍有很多事情需要完成，你帮助洛德完成了与科维兽的合作。

EntratiLabSyndicate.descriptionEn: Animals sent into the Void by Albrecht Entrati, the three surviving Cavia came back changed forever. They gained human intelligence, but could speak only incoherent Voidtongue until the Jahu Gargoyle made them intelligible. Despite what Albrecht did to them, they have resolved to assist his chosen Operator.
EntratiLabSyndicate.descriptionZh: 这三只仅存的科维兽是被阿尔布雷希特·英择谛送入虚空的动物，它们在回来时已经被彻底改变了。它们获得了人类的智力，但只能讲出无法理解的虚空语，直到形态合成兽像将它们的话变得可理解。尽管阿尔布雷希特曾经这么对待它们，但它们还是决定协助他所选择的指挥官。

HexSyndicate.descriptionEn: Formerly human operatives, the six members of the Hex were transformed into Protoframes by Albrecht Entrati. Filled with uncanny power and mourning their lost humanity, they continue their mission of mercy in beleaguered Höllvania.
HexSyndicate.descriptionZh: 六名六人组成员原本是人类特工，后来被阿尔布雷希特·英择谛改造成原型战甲。他们获得了不可思议的力量，但却哀悼着自己失去的人性，继续在被围攻的霍瓦尼亚执行他们的救赎使命。

KahlSyndicate.descriptionEn: Break veils. Free Brothers. Stop Narmer.

NewLokaSyndicate.descriptionEn: Only through the restoration of a pure humanity and the repopulation of Earth can the conflict end. The New Loka are worshipers of the human form and Earth, before its corruption.

CetusSyndicate.name: Ostron

titles.name: /Lotus/Language/Syndicates/CetusTitle5
titles.descriptionEn: You are respected by the Ostron Elders and adored by the children. You have access to their most sought after wares.
titles.descriptionZh: 你受到了 Ostron 长者们的尊重，也被孩童所喜爱。你可以选购他们最炙手可热的商品了。

titles.name: /Lotus/Language/Syndicates/CetusTitle4
titles.descriptionEn: You have earned the trust of the Ostrons. They regard you as a valuable ally.
titles.descriptionZh: 你获得了 Ostron 人的信任，他们认同你是一位值得珍视的盟友。

titles.name: /Lotus/Language/Syndicates/CetusTitle3
titles.descriptionEn: The Ostrons have begun to accept you into their society. They will sell you goods not offered to strangers.
titles.descriptionZh: Ostron 人已经开始认可你融入他们的社会了。他们将会出售一些不卖给外人的商品给你。

titles.name: /Lotus/Language/Syndicates/CetusTitle2
titles.descriptionEn: The Ostrons are intrigued by your presence and are willing to instruct you in their ways.
titles.descriptionZh: Ostron 人对你的存在感到十分好奇，并愿意以他们的方式来教导你。

titles.name: /Lotus/Language/Syndicates/CetusTitle1
titles.descriptionEn: The Ostrons are wary of outsiders. Speak with Konzu to learn how to increase your standing with them.
titles.descriptionZh: Ostron 人对外来者充满戒心。与孔尊对话来了解如何提升你在他们中的声望。

CetusSyndicate.descriptionEn: A tight knit band of merchants, hucksters, and survivors, the Ostrons call Cetus their home. The town was built around an Orokin Tower, that both protects and nourishes them.
CetusSyndicate.descriptionZh: 由一群贸易商、小贩与幸存者紧密结合在一起组成，Ostron 人称希图斯为家园。这座城镇建立在奥罗金塔周边，高塔不但庇护了他们，还滋养了他们。

QuillsSyndicate.name: The Quills

titles.name: /Lotus/Language/Syndicates/QuillsTitle5
titles.descriptionEn: You are a key operative, vital to their efforts, and have access to the Quills' most sought after wares.
titles.descriptionZh: 你是一名关键的特工，对他们而言非常重要，可以获得夜羽最炙手可热的货物。

titles.name: /Lotus/Language/Syndicates/QuillsTitle4
titles.descriptionEn: After much labor The Quills take you into their confidence. You are a trusted ally.
titles.descriptionZh: 经过千辛万苦，夜羽们信任了你。你是可以信赖的盟友。

titles.name: /Lotus/Language/Syndicates/QuillsTitle3
titles.descriptionEn: The Quills consider you a useful resource. They will sell you goods not offered to strangers.
titles.descriptionZh: 夜羽们认为你是一个有用的资源。他们会向你出售不外流的货物。

titles.name: /Lotus/Language/Syndicates/QuillsTitle2
titles.descriptionEn: The Quills reserve some attention for you. They appear willing to involve you in their mysterious efforts.
titles.descriptionZh: 夜羽们稍稍留意了你。他们看起来愿意让你参与到他们神秘的事业中。

titles.name: /Lotus/Language/Syndicates/QuillsTitle1
titles.descriptionEn: The Quills are aware of you. Speak with Quill Onkko to learn how to increase your standing with them.
titles.descriptionZh: 夜羽们意识到了你的存在。与夜羽昂克交谈来了解如何提升你的声望。

QuillsSyndicate.descriptionEn: A secretive order, loyal to the mysterious and reclusive 'Unum.' Some say their relationship to cause and effect is unnatural, their knowledge profane. When a Quill acts, things change.
QuillsSyndicate.descriptionZh: 一个神秘的团体，向神秘隐居的乌努母神效忠。有人说他们与因果有着不自然的联系，而他们的知识是亵渎的。当一名夜羽行动时，情势就将改变。

RedVeilSyndicate.descriptionEn: The Veil see corruption all around them. They are honor-bound to heal the system through a great and violent purge. No cost too great, no blood too precious.
RedVeilSyndicate.descriptionZh: 血色面纱见证了他们周围一切的腐败。他们以荣誉为号召，通过强大的暴力净化来治愈星系。不惜一切代价，不惜流尽鲜血。

SolarisSyndicate.name: Solaris United

titles.name: /Lotus/Language/Syndicates/SolarisTitle5
titles.descriptionEn: Inner circle, mate. Eudico’s right hand. You and SU: one and the same.
titles.descriptionZh: 圈内人，老兄。Eudico 的左右手。你和索联：一心同体。

titles.name: /Lotus/Language/Syndicates/SolarisTitle4
titles.descriptionEn: You’re the go-to gun for the risky stuff. Word is bond.
titles.descriptionZh: 你是处理危险情况的首选。一诺千金。

titles.name: /Lotus/Language/Syndicates/SolarisTitle3
titles.descriptionEn: You seem a solid mucker. The locals are happy to sort you out with odds and ends.
titles.descriptionZh: 你看起来是个实在的伙计。当地人很愿意和你交易些零碎物品。

titles.name: /Lotus/Language/Syndicates/SolarisTitle2
titles.descriptionEn: You get things done, but your loyalties are still unproven.
titles.descriptionZh: 你能办好事情，但是你还没有证明你的忠诚。

titles.name: /Lotus/Language/Syndicates/SolarisTitle1
titles.descriptionEn: Solaris United don’t trust easy, Outworlder. Talk to Eudico.
titles.descriptionZh: 索联不会轻信他人，异世者。和 Eudico 谈谈吧。

SolarisSyndicate.descriptionEn: Risen from the ashes, Solaris United returns to free the Solaris people from their mental shackles and physical servitude. No being should have to work to own their own mind, their own body, their own future.
SolarisSyndicate.descriptionZh: 从灰烬中崛起，索拉里斯联盟为了将索拉里斯人从精神的桎梏和身体的枷锁中解放出来。没有人应该为了拥有独立的精神、身体和未来而强迫工作。

VentKidsSyndicate.name: Ventkids

titles.name: /Lotus/Language/Syndicates/VentkidsTitle5
titles.descriptionEn: Had no say in your biological fam, but this crew's your logical fam. Ventkids are logical; got no time for muckers who ain't.
titles.descriptionZh: 和你的亲生兄弟无话可说，但这里都是你的义亲。通风小子是义亲；不会和不是的家伙浪费时间。

titles.name: /Lotus/Language/Syndicates/VentkidsTitle4
titles.descriptionEn: Stand-up cove and vouched for, this one. Chekchek?
titles.descriptionZh: 敢作敢当的老兄。切克切克？

titles.name: /Lotus/Language/Syndicates/VentkidsTitle3
titles.descriptionEn: Solid sorta mucker and you ride a K-Drive like it's stolen. ‘Cause it is.
titles.descriptionZh: 还算不错的伙计，你骑着仿佛是偷来的 K 式悬浮板。因为确实是偷来的。

titles.name: /Lotus/Language/Syndicates/VentkidsTitle2
titles.descriptionEn: Nice enough; wouldn’t last five minutes in a vent.
titles.descriptionZh: 还不赖，但是在通风管里撑不过五分钟。

titles.name: /Lotus/Language/Syndicates/VentkidsTitle1
titles.descriptionEn: No dings, never taken a hit, wouldn't know ya ta look at ya. Have you even ridden a K-Drive?
titles.descriptionZh: 经验全无，从来没有尝试过的菜鸟，路人脸。你连 K 式悬浮板都没用过吧？

VentKidsSyndicate.descriptionEn: Hangin' with their logical fam in the ducts of Fortuna, the Ventkids get by stealing parts from the Corpus and running K-Drive races out on the Vallis. At night the ventways bang to the sound of skeg - to the chagrin of the locals.
VentKidsSyndicate.descriptionZh: 和他们的义亲们住在福尔图娜的管道中。通风小子以偷取 Corpus 的零件为生，并在山谷中进行 K 式悬浮板的比赛。到了晚上，通风管道会响起管道乐，让当地人大为懊恼。

VoxSyndicate.name: Vox Solaris

titles.name: /Lotus/Language/Syndicates/VoxSolTitle5
titles.descriptionEn: You are one of us. Together we reach from the darkness to reclaim our future.
titles.descriptionZh: 你是我们的一分子。我们共同从黑暗里走出来，重夺属于我们的将来。

titles.name: /Lotus/Language/Syndicates/VoxSolTitle4
titles.descriptionEn: The best of our best. Your acts are legendary. Your acts can never be known.
titles.descriptionZh: 我们当中最好的。你的作为很有传奇性。你的作为永远不为人知。

titles.name: /Lotus/Language/Syndicates/VoxSolTitle3
titles.descriptionEn: Glad to have you with us. We say, you do. We have been waiting for you, to deliver upon them a terrible ruin.
titles.descriptionZh: 很高兴你和我们一起。我们说，你就做。我们一直在等你，为他们带来可怕的毁灭。

titles.name: /Lotus/Language/Syndicates/VoxSolTitle2
titles.descriptionEn: Got a good feeling about you, kid.
titles.descriptionZh: 对你颇具好感，小伙子。

titles.name: /Lotus/Language/Syndicates/VoxSolTitle1
titles.descriptionEn: We watch, we anticipate, we intercede. We're just getting started.
titles.descriptionZh: 我们监察，我们预测，我们斡旋。我们才刚开始。

VoxSyndicate.descriptionEn: Solaris United's core personnel operating under the name of that group's enigmatic and anonymous figurehead. SU is the public face of the struggle. Vox Solaris is something else entirely; something known only to Eudico... and the Quills.
VoxSyndicate.descriptionZh: 索拉里斯联盟的核心成员借以行事的匿名神秘领袖形象。索联是奋斗反抗的代表。而索拉里斯之声则完全是另一种存在，只有 Eudico……和夜羽才知道这其中的秘密。

SteelMeridianSyndicate.descriptionEn: Led by a battle-hardened Grineer deserter, the Steel Meridian fight a guerrilla war against a vast enemy. They are sworn protectors of what little remains of the colonies.
SteelMeridianSyndicate.descriptionZh: 由一位久经沙场的 Grineer 叛逃者所带领，钢铁防线以游击战来对抗一个巨大的敌人。他们宣誓要保护那一小块残存的殖民地。

ZarimanSyndicate.name: The Holdfasts

titles.name: /Lotus/Language/Syndicates/ZarimanTitle5
titles.descriptionEn: You have become the savior both of the Zariman and of her last remaining crew.
titles.descriptionZh: 你成为了「扎里曼号」和她仅存船员的救星。

titles.name: /Lotus/Language/Syndicates/ZarimanTitle4
titles.descriptionEn: You have undone the worst that the Void could do, and humanity is within reach.
titles.descriptionZh: 你已经复原了虚空所做的一切坏事，并且人性近在咫尺。

titles.name: /Lotus/Language/Syndicates/ZarimanTitle3
titles.descriptionEn: Trust has taken root and begun to grow, even in this desolate place.
titles.descriptionZh: 信任已经开始生根发芽，即使是在这个荒凉之地。

titles.name: /Lotus/Language/Syndicates/ZarimanTitle2
titles.descriptionEn: With memory comes remorse... but also responsibility.
titles.descriptionZh: 记忆带来悔恨……还有责任。

titles.name: /Lotus/Language/Syndicates/ZarimanTitle1
titles.descriptionEn: The Holdfasts are now more than strangers to you... and to themselves.
titles.descriptionZh: 现在，坚守者对你……和他们自己来说，已经不仅仅是陌生人了。
